name: Cartelord
look: a sinister tobacco-bale scarecrow in a pinstriped suit and fedora, red eyes under the brim, a cigar holder
entry: Cartelord controls vast swaths of farmland. Once a Pokémon gets a taste of the sweet nectar it produces, it refuses to eat anything else.
how: Evolve Curedrake at level 38 while it holds a King's Rock or a Relic Coin (the item is used up).
Wild: rare in the Ashtray Wastes (an overworld biome added by CobbleEffort: Kanto).
Its ability Hooked keeps any Pokémon that touches it from switching out on the next turn.
